name: Green Strip - One time Bandage - Full Box - 100pcs
description:
Green Strip - One time Bandage - Full Box - 100pcs 
MADE IN CHINA 
One time Bandage Green Strip allows sweat & moisture to evaporate.100 sterile assorted sizes. 
A non-Stick pad won't stick to the wound. 
Sterility guaranteed unless an individual wrapper has been opened or damaged. 
If skin irritation occurs, discontinue use. 
Waterproof, breathe freely, flexible, non-stick Plastic BandageStandard 
Size (72 mm x 19 mm)Two different Pack size (100 strips )
